**3. Use your CCTV as a visible deterrent at your entry/exit**
With one entry and exit and three cameras, position them to cover that single entry/exit point so customers see the surveillance.

The document describes Target's approach to anti-shoplifting: placing a camera "right at eye level" so the customer sees "your own face staring back at you," with a reminder that "'You're being monitored.'"
This is a customer-awareness tactic that makes shoppers aware they are being watched, and it can be done with your existing cameras.
